title: Reliability Crossroads: Implementation Sprint Notes (90d)
content:
Purpose:
This notebook captures the pragmatic 90-day implementation plan for the Crossroads reliability initiative — an intentionally lightweight, cross-functional effort to standardize SLO design, measurement, error-budget operations, and rollout rituals across model-serving and control-plane surfaces. Intended audience: SREs, platform eng, serving runtime, product owners, and Solutions Engineering leads.

Scope (what we will ship in 90d):
- SLO definition template (service-level objectives + stakeholder questions) for model-serving APIs and the control plane.
- Baseline instrumentation checklist (metrics/logs/traces + dashboards) and an automated onboarding pipeline for new services.
- 3 pilot services onboarded end-to-end (one hosted-api route, one dedicated cluster, one private-deploy gateway).
- Error budget policy prototype and automated notifications tied to oncall and product slack channels.
- Runbook skeletons for degraded inference (latency spikes, KV-cache corruption, out-of-memory fallback).

High-level success metrics (quantifiable):
- 3 production services with SLOs and dashboards by end of week 12.
- <10% variance between measured latency percentiles reported by telemetry and the serving runtime internal logs for pilot routes.
- Error budget burn alerting configured and exercised in 2 tabletop drills.
- Developer onboarding time for SLO-enabled service reduced from 7 days -> 2 days (measured by self-report / onboarding tickets).

Stakeholders & Roles:
- SRE Lead (owner): Priya Patel — program coordinator, runbook approvals, incident exercises.
- Platform Engineering: Evan Morales — automation of onboarding pipeline, infra templates.
- Serving Runtime Eng: Ava Chen — telemetry hooks, kernel selection instrumentation, low-level metrics.
- Product (Hosted API): Mateo Rivera — SLO signoff, product impact mapping.
- Solutions Eng / Customer Success: Sofia Alvarez — pilot customer coordination, external comms.
- Observability (Console): Linh Tran — dashboards, alert thresholds, UX of SLO page.

Working assumptions (explicit):
- We will treat 99th latency and availability as primary SLI families for model-serving. Error rate SLOs will be scoped by route-type (generation vs embeddings).
- Telemetry (Prometheus + OTLP) is available for all pilot services; if gaps exist, serving runtime team to add lightweight counters/kvs.
- We will not attempt full cross-region replication within 90d; focus is measurement+ops.

Week-by-week sprint outline (12 weeks):
- Week 0 (planning): stakeholder align, finalize pilot services, freeze success metrics. Owners assigned.
- Weeks 1-3 (instrumentation + templates): implement SLO definition template, baseline metric collectors, and dashboard skeletons.
- Weeks 4-6 (automation + onboarding): build heartbeat pipeline to generate dashboard + SLO artifacts given a service descriptor. Create terraform module for metrics exporters.
- Weeks 7-9 (pilot rollouts): onboard three pilot services, iterate on SLO thresholds, run one simulated error-budget burn drill.
- Weeks 10-11 (operationalize): finalize runbooks, alert routing, and escalation flows. Run cross-team tabletop.
- Week 12 (retro & handoff): measure success metrics, collect feedback, prepare playbook for broader ramp.

Top milestones & deliverables:
- SLO template v1 (doc + example) — deliverable by end of Week 2 (owner: Priya).
- Onboarding pipeline MVP + docs — Week 5 (owner: Evan).
- Serving runtime telemetry shim PR merged — Week 3 (owner: Ava).
- Dashboards + alerts for three pilots — Week 8 (owner: Linh).
- Two tabletop drills executed, with action logs — Week 10 (owner: Priya).
- Final playbook & ticket templates for ongoing adoption — Week 12 (owner: Mateo/Sofia).

Playbooks & templates we will create (short notes):
- SLO definition checklist (who cares? what do we measure? what are consumer-impact windows?) — goal: simple Qs, not long-form.
- Measurement verification script — small python tool that compares Prometheus-derived percentiles vs raw runtime logs for a given time window.
- Error budget policy YAML — defines notification thresholds, automated throttles (if applicable), and temporary rollback triggers.
- Runbook template for degraded inference — includes: detection, mitigation ladder (fast fallback -> scale -> degrade features), communications snippet.

Risks, mitigations, and unknowns:
- Risk: Telemetry gaps in legacy services. Mitigation: prioritize pilot choices to include an easy-to-instrument service; add short-term sidecar exporter for legacy APIs.
- Risk: Discrepancy between runtime metrics and aggregated telemetry. Mitigation: measurement verification script + targeted profiling session.
- Unknown: Exact thresholds acceptable to product teams for embeddings routes. Action: schedule a 30m decision meeting Week 2 (owner Mateo).
- Risk: Alert fatigue if thresholds are tuned too aggressively. Mitigation: run error-budget drills, iterate thresholds conservatively.

Communication cadence & rituals:
- Weekly Crossroads Standup (30m) — Monday 10am PT, rotating facilitator. Attendees: owners and pilot leads.
- Biweekly SLO Review (1h) — review dashboards, outstanding measurement diffs, product impact logs.
- Oncall tabletop (simulated burn) — Week 9 and Week 11.
- Slack channel: #reliability-crossroads (use for async updates, link to runbooks and decision logs).

Instrumentation checklist (quick):
- Request latency histogram (p50, p90, p99) tagged by route and model-version.
- Success/failure counters with error classification (4xx, 5xx, model-nan/invalid-response).
- KV cache hit/miss ratio and eviction counts for cached prefix queries.
- Pod/instance OOM and GPU mem pressure counters.
- Trace sampling for slow requests (include span for kernel selection + batch scheduling).

Rollout & canary approach (pilot):
- Canary %: start 1% -> 5% -> 20% over two days with automated rollback on error budget threshold.
- Metric gating: require p99 latency within 1.3x baseline and no >5% error-rate spike for generation routes.
- Fallbacks: route to thinner quantized model variant if latencies exceed gating thresholds; notify ops.

Acceptance criteria for SLO onboarding (per service):
- SLO doc completed and approved by product owner.
- Dashboards show 7 days of telemetry and match runtime logs within tolerance.
- Alerting configured and validated in staging with synthetic traffic.
- Runbook attached to service and reviewed by oncall for that pager rotation.

Open decision log (placeholders):
- DD-01: SLO window length (30d vs 90d). Owner: Priya. Status: decide by Week 2.
- DD-02: Default SLO families for embeddings routes (latency vs availability). Owner: Mateo. Status: meeting Week 2.

Immediate next actions (this week):
- Priya: finalize pilot roster and ping product leads (due: 2025-11-14).
- Ava: raise telemetry shim PR for hosted-api pilot, include p99 timers (due: 2025-11-17) — refer to PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/248.
- Evan: scaffold onboarding pipeline repo + README (due: 2025-11-21).
- Linh: draft dashboard wireframes and post screenshots in #reliability-crossroads (due: 2025-11-20).

Notes to self / scratchpad (informal):
- Keep SLO language simple. Product teams hate long legalese.
- Consider a lightweight "SLO Quick Pass" for small teams — template + 15m review.
- We might want to capture cost impact per SLO guardrail later (optimize interplay of batching vs latency).

References & links:
- Confluence: Crossroads Implementation Overview (linked in metadata).
- JIRA: SRE-4021 (onboarding pipeline epic), PROD-5178 (pilot alerting fixes).
- GitHub: observability PR for telemetry shim.

End of notes. Add comments here as you run experiments — tag owner for follow-up items.

Decision snapshots (for quick copy to status emails):
- Nov 10: Program kickoff. Pilots chosen: hosted-api/generate-route, dedicated-cluster/inference-batch, private-gateway/ingest.
- Jan 22: Expect dashboard parity check and first tabletop completed.

Action log (short):
- [Priya] 2025-11-12: follow up with product on SLO priority list.
- [Evan] 2025-11-18: initial pipeline scaffolding pushed.
- [Ava] 2025-11-20: telemetry shim merged to staging.
